Business_Definition: A person registered to receive care in the cluster, identified in the person master.
Notes: Phase 8 term. Context for CDE-001 / CDE-002

Business_Definition: The cluster patient identifier (MRN) used to locate the person in operational systems.
The national identity number captured at registration where required.
The recorded date of birth used to confirm identity and derive age.
The administrative gender recorded at registration, using the approved value set.
A clinician or practitioner identity used for care delivery and credentialing, distinct from the HR employee record.
The unique identifier of the practitioner in the credentialing master.
An organizational location in the cluster reference structure (hospital or other delivery site as used in org master).
Business_Data_Steward: Enterprise Data / PMO Analyst within DMO
Notes: Phase 8 term. Outside catalog MVP. DMO hosts Steward; DMO is not Owner

Business_Definition: An organizational unit within a facility (or cluster structure) as represented in organizational reference data.
Business_Data_Steward: Enterprise Data / PMO Analyst within DMO

Business_Definition: The reference code that identifies a facility or department in organizational master data.
Business_Data_Steward: Enterprise Data / PMO Analyst within DMO

Business_Definition: A defined care interaction or visit recorded in the clinical record context.
The unique identifier of a recorded care encounter.
The date (and, where used, time) associated with encounter documentation.
Notes: Maps to CDE-004 Encounter documentation timestamp

Business_Definition: The recorded start of an inpatient (or equivalent) stay, where used.
Notes: Phase 8 sample term. Not a new CDE

Business_Definition: The date the inpatient (or equivalent) stay is recorded as started.
The recorded end of an inpatient (or equivalent) stay, where used.
Notes: Phase 8 sample term. Not a new CDE

Business_Definition: The date the inpatient (or equivalent) stay is recorded as ended.
A recorded clinical diagnosis (coded or structured) in the medical record context.
A billing/claims record submitted or prepared for reimbursement of services.
The unique identifier of a claim record in the governed claims population.
A billed service / charge code used in the revenue cycle.
A data element whose quality has a material effect on identity, care operations, eligibility, safety, or executive reporting, confirmed through the Phase 7 two-step method.

Business_Definition: A governed unit registered in the catalog (Dataset, Table, Report, Dashboard, or Master Data Entity).
Governed information about a data asset: meaning, ownership, classification, source, and trust of the description. Not the underlying data.
Notes: Publishing metadata is not a data release

Business_Definition: The Rafid working label applied to a dataset (Public / Internal / Confidential / Restricted) using the Phase 5 method.
